meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this index was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.

modules.id: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. 'module-auth'. Never changed after creation.
modules.name: Human-readable module name, e.g. 'Authentication'.
modules.description: One or two sentences describing what this module covers from a business perspective.
modules.screen_ids: List of screen IDs belonging to this module (references screen-index).
